overview: Tiling is the field concerned with Setting tile that lasts: layout, thinset, and grout for floors, walls, and showers. What Tiling Studies belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Layout — centering patterns so cut tiles land symmetrically and full where seen. And Setting — beating tiles into full mortar coverage, especially in wet areas. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Foundations tier.

Setting: beating tiles into full mortar coverage, especially in wet areas.
